description.narrative:
The GET.pro multi-donor programme aims to scale-up joint action on international energy and climate goals. The program offers three instruments addressing key elements of a successful energy transition: - GET.invest mobilises private investments in clean energy by building a pipeline of bankable investment projects. - GET.transform supports partner governments in advancing their energy transition via targeted transformation advice. - The Secretariat of the Africa-EU Energy Partnership (AEEP) promotes strategic political dialogue between Africa and Europe on energy.
GET.pro’s overarching objective is to improve the conditions for investments in a global energy transformation in a concerted European approach. The program sets out to achieve the following concrete and ambitious performance targets, linked to the above mentioned three instruments: - 146 clean energy projects have reached financial close that leverage 1,288m EUR investment. - Energy sector governance, planning and regulation for a power system transformation has been enhanced in 2 regions and 8 partner countries. - The new Africa-Europe cooperation framework in the energy sector is being implemented advancing the energy transition in Europe and Africa.
The GET.Pro agreement targets Sub-Saharan Africa and Latin-America, with particular focus on Mozambique, Uganda, Namibia, Eswatini, Lesotho, Peru, Panama, Guatemala, El Salvador, Costa Rica, Honduras and Nicaragua.
